title: Connection termination and idle timing need end-to-end evidence
remediation: Deployment service and network operators and component maintainers approve idle limits and normal termination behavior for each assessed connection type. Observe the transport closing on end-of-session and at the effective idle threshold, including intermediate gateways where applicable. Distinguish a closed connection from invalidation of an application token under SC-23.

milestones.title: Collect approved inactivity limits, effective service and gateway configurations, and measured transport closure records
